news.headline: Rescuers Warm Up Chilly Sea Turtles
news.body: When ocean water drops below 50°F, sea turtles can get too cold to swim or eat. This is called cold stunning, and every winter hundreds wash up on Massachusetts beaches. Rescuers take them to special turtle hospitals and warm them up slowly, about 5°F a day. In recent years, about three-quarters of the rescued turtles got better and were released back to the ocean.

news.headline: One Ant Can Wake a Whole Colony
news.body: Acorn ant colonies often rest quietly, then suddenly the whole nest bursts into action with no leader in charge. A new computer model shows that one ant starting to move can set off the rest, like falling dominoes. Each ant it bumps starts moving too. Scientists still need to test the idea with real ants.

fun_fact: Honey never spoils! Jars of honey found in ancient Egyptian tombs were still good to eat after thousands of years. 🍯

joke.q: Why did the turtle cross the road?
joke.a: To get to the shell station! 🐢

riddle.q: What can you break without ever touching it?

word_of_the_day.meaning: to happen at the same time or move together
word_of_the_day.sentence: The ants seem to synchronize, all waking up at once.

this_day_in_history: On November 14, 1889, reporter Nellie Bly set out from New York to race around the world. She finished in 72 days, faster than anyone had before! 🌍
did_you_know: A group of turtles is sometimes called a bale, and sea turtles can hold their breath for hours while resting. 🐢
